changes.local: We define the magnetic field strength [MATH] in terms of the force on a charged particle moving in a magnetic field. The SI unit for magnetic field strength [MATH] is called the tesla (T) after the eccentric but brilliant inventor Nikola Tesla (1856–1943). To determine how the tesla relates to other SI units, we solve for the magnetic field strength.
